title: Oreo catacomb brownies
creator: emsfoodiefix
statusNote: Only the Oreo skull decoration is explained. Use any brownie recipe for the base.

items.note: or a tray of your favourite brownies

steps: Blitz the Oreos and mix with a little cream into a mouldable dough.
Press into mini skull moulds and chill until firm.
Unmould and arrange the skulls on top of a tray of brownies.
